purpose: Separate usable narrower evidence from satisfaction of the frozen CX004 benchmark and from the decision to propose new measurements.

frozen_readouts.R01: Late adult identity in the relevant age-positive human cells, including the benchmark D28 window.
frozen_readouts.R02: Calibrated per-cell unusual-state annotations and adequate effective sampling under the same protocol.
frozen_readouts.R03: Matched late human factor-off cells with verified withdrawal chronology and a sufficient recovery follow-up.
frozen_readouts.R04: A common measured trajectory connecting the relevant intermediate and late windows.

question_levels.question: Can source-provided predictions and contrasts be extracted and checked?
Do the exact model and preprocessing reproduce keyed reference predictions?
question_levels.requires: Historical model and all necessary input transformations and references.

question_levels.question: Are age-related and identity measures interpretable after verified withdrawal in donor-matched populations?
question_levels.requires: Matched observations, controls, chronology and calibrated endpoints; exact benchmark dates are a separate requirement.

question_levels.question: Did the same cells improve and retain identity through recovery?
question_levels.requires: Suitable joint measurements and justified longitudinal or lineage linkage.

question_levels.question: Does an appropriate retinal or RPE functional endpoint improve in the relevant system?
question_levels.requires: Ocular-system observations and endpoint-specific joins and controls.

decision_rules: Complete newly feasible bounded computations before closing the campaign.
Classify exact author-held inputs separately from observations that have not been established to exist.
A mismatch with the frozen benchmark timepoints does not prove that all broader biological questions require a new experiment.
No finite public search proves universal absence of data or unconditional wet-lab necessity.
Synthetic data may test assumptions and measurement design; it does not satisfy an observed biological readout.
An experimental proposal is conditional on the intended claim, unavailable reusable observations, partner feasibility, funding and separate authorization.
